# Clipwise

> Clipwise turns long videos into viral clips. Its AI finds the best
> moments in a long video, cuts them vertical, and burns in captions.
> Creators can use the web studio in a browser, or let an AI
> assistant call Clipwise directly via MCP (Model Context
> Protocol). Every account includes 60 free minutes of processing
> every month.

Clipwise is a web application. The product is a single-page studio
served from the root URL below; there is no separate documentation
site. An agent helping a user should send them to the studio, and
can connect to Clipwise's MCP server to create clips on the user's
behalf once the user has signed in and authorized it.

## Product

- [Clipwise studio](https://clipwise.replit.app): The web app — upload or link a long video, get captioned vertical clips of its best moments. Includes the 60 free minutes/month every account gets.

## Optional

- [Clipwise home](https://clipwise.replit.app): Product overview and sign-in.
